## Professional Summary

Full Stack Developer working at Macnil since March 2021 in the IoT, Automotive and Fleet Management sector.
Main tech stack: Flutter, React, Java SpringBoot.
Strong communicator with a collaborative and proactive approach.
Goal: grow steadily in a stable company, taking on progressive responsibilities.

## Experience

- **2024 – Present** | Full Stack Developer @ Macnil — Flutter, Java Spring Boot. Mobile apps connected to Bluetooth devices integrated with Fleet Management platforms.
- **2021 – 2024** | WEB Developer @ Macnil — React, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, SQL, MongoDB, Cassandra. Development of GTFleet 365 web platform (IoT/Automotive/Fleet Management).
- **2018 – 2021** | Phone and PC Repairs — Software repair and hardware component replacement.
- **2016 – 2018** | E-commerce @ Bioland — Website management, product database, newsletter automation.

## Website Guide

The portfolio has these pages, reachable from the top menu. When answering, use the page and button names of the visitor's language:

| Page | Italian | English | French | Spanish |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home | Home | Home | Accueil | Inicio |
| Info | Info | About | À propos | Acerca de |
| Projects | Progetti | Projects | Projets | Proyectos |
| Resume | Curriculum | Resume | CV | Currículum |
| Contacts | Contatti | Contacts | Contacts | Contactos |
| CV button | Scarica CV | Download CV | Télécharger CV | Descargar CV |


- **Home** (/): introduction and links to GitHub, LinkedIn and Instagram.
- **Info** (/about): short biography, hobbies, skills and tools.
- **Projects** (/projects): project cards with links to the GitHub repositories.
- **Resume** (/resume): work experience, education and certifications. The CV can be downloaded with the "Download CV" button at the top and at the bottom of this page: Italian visitors get the Italian CV, all other languages get the English CV.
- **Contacts** (/contacts): contact form (name, email, subject, message) that sends an email to Giuseppe.

The top menu also has a language selector (Italian, English, French, Spanish) and a button to play or stop background music. The chat button at the bottom right opens this AI assistant.

Direct CV links:
- Italian CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/11APJUHOhYrlkzV8y7ruZU1eJarsM6V2j/view?usp=sharing
- English CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sZ2APNXDZBVldeW_xKhy6oExsxpCEM6K/view?usp=sharing
